ev.q: four cases of AIPH among full-term infants were reported in the Boston, Massachusetts, area
the findings are from a case series; because no comparison group was used, definitive conclusions cannot be made
All four infants had symptoms of upper respiratory illness
One S. chartarum spore was found in the basement of one home
The four infants were male and, at onset of illness, had a median age of 48 days
CDC, in collaboration with the Massachusetts Department of Public Health (MDPH), investigated this cluster

methods_quotes.q: Air samples were tested to identify total spores and culturable fungi.
In each area, air sampling was performed under varying conditions
Floor registers and electrical outlets were sampled to detect reservoirs of mold
